yt_title: Day 9: The Safest Building on Earth. Empty for 40 Days. The Log Says Why.
short:
Day 9. 180 feet above the ocean. The safest building on Earth. One helideck, one ladder. They can't swim, they can't climb.

Rule 1: raise the boat-landing ladder.
Rule 2: keep the helideck lights off.
Rule 3: read the log before you touch anything.

60 bunks. A year of food. Zero ways up.

6:20 PM. 39 days of entries. Every one routine. The fortieth is four words.
cta:
“It came by radio.”

And the winter fuel isn't here. It's 400 miles further south. On the ice.

Do you read the rest of the log? 👇
Follow for Day 10 — the finale ✦
